verdict.rationale: SerpApi is itself a public API. It documents a REST endpoint (`https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google`) with extensive per-engine parameters, `json`/`html`/`md` output formats, async submission with archive retrieval, and official client libraries. LLM-oriented docs (llms.txt, .md pages) were confirmed reachable by probe, and community users describe it as a working machine interface for scripts and AI tools. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (every candidate path returned 404).
